levels.title: The Animal Kingdom in One Level
levels.objective: After this level you can explain what makes an animal an animal and name the main groups.

levels.title: How Many Species?
levels.objective: After this level you can explain how many animal species are known and how many may exist.

levels.title: Backbone or Not
levels.objective: After this level you can tell vertebrates, which have backbones, from invertebrates.

levels.title: Checkpoint: What Makes an Animal
